about: NPC activities (minigames) and when they are offered; read by scripts/learning/activity_board.gd. Each id is '<kind>_<npc or store>' (the shop ids follow data/shops.json). 'chance' (0 to 1) is the probability the NPC offers its activity, rolled when the player arrives (shop: entering the store's zone; Dr. Li: coming within her calling distance) and once at start-up. 'progress' is how many rounds a session needs (0: no progress bar); only rounds answered right the first time count, and reaching it ends the session with the NPC's thanks. Only one activity runs at a time: another NPC politely refuses meanwhile. User decisions, 4 Nov 2026: every chance 1.0 for testing; family 20, the grocery order is one round with no bar. 5 Nov 2026: the warehouse (Ramón) is 5 tasks per session; a task counts when done, however many tries it took. 5 Nov 2026: the airport flight game (Captain Bruno) is 5 flights per session, counted only when found on the first tap. 6 Nov 2026: the Alta Cocina restaurant game (Twinkle) is one meal of 4 courses per session; a course counts once the right dish is served, however many tries it took. See docs/guides/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_PART1.md#shared-dialogue-popups-and-settings--4-november-2026. 6 Nov 2026: the police lineup (Officer Rocco, crocodile) and the evidence game (Officer Mimi, cat) are 4 rounds each; a round counts once solved, however many tries it took (docs/evidence/police-detective-20261106/PROMPT.md). 6 Nov 2026: the Grammar Classroom (Lana, school) is 10 questions per class (5 since 14 Nov 2026, each miss repeated once, at most 10); the bar shows the points (right answers) (docs/guides/GRAMMAR_CLASS.md). 8 Nov 2026: the warehouse (Ramón) is 10 tasks per session (user decision, for testing), and at the end Ramón asks to play again. 9 Nov 2026: Hong Kong mahjong with Mei (cat plush) at the table in front of the home is one hand per game with no progress bar (docs/guides/MAHJONG.md). 9 Nov 2026: 'kind' is 'learning' (the default) or 'pastime' (played for fun, no tested word: mahjong); the test launcher (scripts/ui/game_launcher.gd) groups the games by it and may set another number of rounds for one test game (activity_board.gd set_rounds()); 'progress' 0 plays one round (one order, one hand). 9 Nov 2026: Radar Patrol (docs/guides/RADAR_PATROL.md) is a pastime with no NPC, started by a click or E on either control-tower radar; chance 0 (never offered), one endless game (the launcher's rounds do not apply). 9 Nov 2026: Mystery Doors with Madame Luna (cat plush) in the Mystery House is 6 doors per game; a door counts when opened at the first try (docs/guides/TOWN_DESIGN_BRIEF.md 'Mystery House and Mystery Doors'). 9 Nov 2026: electrical box repair (docs/guides/ELECTRICAL_BOX.md) is a pastime with no NPC, started by E near or a click on any electrical box; chance 0 (never offered), one puzzle per opening (the launcher's rounds do not apply; its Play opens the nearest box). 18 Nov 2026 (user): progression (scripts/learning/game_progress.gd; docs/guides/MINIGAMES.md#progression): 'levels' is a game's list of level settings, level 1 first, whose keys the game reads (Grocery Run: data/shops.json order rules, an empty order_words = every product sold there, 'order_tiers' n = the products of the store's first n price tiers; Pay Up! was retired into the Grocery Run checkout on 21 Nov 2026); 'stars_at' (default [1.0, 0.6]) is the share of rounds right first time needed for 3 and 2 stars. A game without 'levels' has no progression. 18 Nov 2026: the bank teller game (bear banker, teller window 2) is 5 customers per session; a customer counts when served right the first time (exact cash, or a correct 'not enough money'). 24 Nov 2026: Feeding Time! (Nico, sheep zookeeper at the zoo food booth; docs/game/minigames.md#feeding-time) has levels: 'requests' is how many animals a session asks for (the picker's rounds win over it) and 'tiers' the word tiers (data/words.json) of the zoo animals it may name; 'progress' 5 is the picker's default and the stars' measure. 25 Nov 2026 (user: different songs for different activities): 'music' names the game's background track while it runs (a track in data/sounds.json music.tracks, sound.gd); none = the town track. Five moods: quiz, errands, mystery, focus, outdoors. 25 Nov 2026 (user D11, LEARN-06): every learning game's designed levels are built; each game's level keys are listed in docs/guides/MINIGAMES.md#progression and what they change on its learning card (docs/game/minigames.md). 'questions' / 'doors' replace 'progress' for that level (the picker's rounds still win when changed); the restaurant's 'difficulty' merges over data/restaurant_game.json's; the police games' keys merge over data/detective_game.json's lineup or evidence.
